== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Sector]] [[Eleven]] is a collection of worlds, or iterations, within [[Way|the Way]]. It contains several strategically significant locations, including [[Asylum]], [[Amalgam]], and [[Cradle]] ([[Iteration 110]]). Fathom serves as the sector's most vital component, acting as a lynchpin due to its massive population and highly stable connection to [[Way|the Way]]; this stability helps support the other iterations within the sector. Because of its importance, the [[Vroshir]] have targeted [[Sector]] [[Eleven]] for [[destruction]], specifically attempting to isolate it and destroy Fathom. [[The Mad King]] has worked to seal off the sector, creating barriers in [[Way|the Way]] to prevent outside help from reaching it. While the [[Abidan]] typically protect important worlds like [[Cradle]], the sector has faced extreme threats from the [[Vroshir]], who have sought to surround and ruin it.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Sector]] [[Eleven]] is a vast region containing various [[Iterations]], including the worlds of [[Cradle]] and [[Asylum]].
